messages:
alex: FYI we got an enterprise ticket where ~20 users lost roles after an Okta group sync. Customer says they merged two accounts on their side and we ended up dropping role bindings for the merged account.

maya: Oh no. Do we have the SCIM payload / connector logs? Is this the Okta group push flow or SCIM bulk import?

alex: Okta group push. Pasting sanitized snippets. Note: two different users with externalId casing differences were merged on customer side (UserA externalId: 'john.doe' and 'John.Doe'). Our logs show a PATCH that replaced members array with the merged id.

alex: ```
PATCH /Groups/0ab1c2d3-4e5f-6789-0abc-def123456789
{
  "members": [ { "value": "ext|users|12345" } ]
}
-> 200 OK
```

alex: Immediately after, SCIM connector ran a user delta reconcile and we logged: 
`WARN scim.sync - user externalId collision detected -> choosing canonical id ext|users|12345; orphaned role bindings: 18`

samir: That warning means our normalization matched both externalIds to same canonical key. We currently lowercase and strip whitespace during match. If customer merged at identity provider level (backfilled externalId), our matching can conflate distinct internal identities if they used different externalId formats earlier.

jordan: Can you dump the role_binding table for that canonical id (sanitized)? Need to see which role rows were left unlinked. Also, did the group -> role mapping rely on group.externalId or group.displayName?

alex: group mapping is by group.externalId. The weird bit: group push replaced the group members list with only the merged okta user id, so we removed the prior member rows for the other externalId before reconcile could map roles. DB snapshot (sanitized):
```
role_bindings (before):
- binding_id: rb_111, user_external_id: ext|users|12344, role: admin
- binding_id: rb_112, user_external_id: ext|users|12345, role: analyst

role_bindings (after):
- binding_id: rb_112, user_external_id: ext|users|12345, role: analyst
```

alex: rb_111 vanished because user_external_id ext|users|12344 was considered duplicate and not reconciled to ext|users|12345.

maya: So the lost roles belonged to the account that got merged away. We need to either migrate those old bindings to the canonical user or restore them. Customer is blocked.

samir: Short-term: reassign orphaned bindings to canonical id via admin API. I can prepare a script. Long-term: change reconciliation to preserve per-previous-external-id role bindings and surface collisions for manual review.

ops-ryan: +1 on manual review. Also suggest we introduce a reconcile-safe mode: when collision detected, pause group member removals for 5m and emit an alert to the org admin so they can confirm merge intent.

scim-bot: Reconcile job #rk-2026-03-17-09:42 completed. results: 1 collision detected, 18 orphaned role_bindings identified, 0 automatic migrations applied.

jordan: Can you run a one-off migration to reattach the 18 bindings to ext|users|12345, and create an audit log entry that links to the customer's merge ticket? We'll need customer approval/consent before changing bindings.

alex: I'll queue the migration and ping the customer for approval. Preparing a PR for migration script and a doc change to make collisions visible in the Console (Notifications -> Provisioning collisions).

maya: For postmortem: record root cause = externalId casing/format divergence + immediate group replacement flow. Actions: (1) migration script, (2) UI alert, (3) reconciler change to not drop bindings on collision, (4) update docs and send customer guidance for Okta merge best practices.

samir: I'll own (3). Estimate 2 sprints for safe rollout (includes tests for race between PATCH group and reconcile).

ops-ryan: I'll run the migration once customer confirms and coordinate an emergency deploy window if needed. Also recommend notifying support to watch for similar tickets (we can run a query for collisions last 90 days).

alex: Customer responded: "Yes please proceed with reattaching the roles, we approve." I'll attach consent to ticket and run migration in staging then prod.

jordan: Nice. While migrating, let's add a small telemetry event scim.collision.migration.started/stopped with counts so we can measure impact.

alex: Done — created ticket internal-4287, assigned migration to samir, ops-ryan scheduled run at 2026-03-17T20:00Z.

maya: Thanks team. After migration, we'll follow up with a short postmortem to the customer and propose the Console UX change. :thumbsup:

samir: quick note — I found one edgecase: if the merged-away account had SSO-linked secondary emails, we should snapshot them before migration so we don't lose contact metadata. I'll include that in script.

ops-ryan: 👍 will prepare rollback steps.

scim-bot: runbook update suggested: add 'collision alert' step under provisioning incidents.

alex: closing loop here. Will post result in this thread after migration completes.

maya: Thanks — please ping #customer-success for a broadcast to CSMs once done.

alex: will do.
